P.name: Serpentine Grace
P.description: {{sbc|Innate:}} '''Cassiopeia''' increases the effectiveness of all {{as|movement speed}} bonuses by {{pplevel|5 to 36|key=%}}.

P.name: Serpentine Grace 2
P.description: {{sbc|Innate:}} '''Cassiopeia''' increases the effectiveness of all {{as|movement speed}} bonuses by {{pplevel|5 to 36|key=%}}.

Q.name: Noxious Blast
Q.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Cassiopeia''' creates a blast at the target location that explodes after a {{fd|0.4}}-second delay. Enemies within the blast are {{tip|poison|poisoned}} for 3 seconds, taking {{as|magic damage}} every {{ap|3/7|round=3}} seconds over the duration.
Q.leveling: {{st|Total Magic Damage|{{ap|65 to 205}} {{as|(+ 75% AP)}}|Magic Damage Per Tick|{{ap|65/7 to 205/7|round=2}} {{as|(+ {{ap|75/7|round=2}}% AP)}}}}
Q.description2: If ''Noxious Blast'' hits an enemy {{tip|champion}}, '''Cassiopeia''' gains {{sti|ms|{{as|'''bonus''' movement speed}}}} that decays over 3 seconds.

W.name: Miasma
W.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Cassiopeia''' spews forth 7 bolts of venom in an arc at the target location, creating toxic clouds at the area for 5 seconds.
W.description2: Enemies within the clouds are {{tip|poison|poisoned}} to take {{as|magic damage}} every {{ap|5/19|round=3}} seconds and become {{tip|ground|grounded}} and {{tip|slow|slowed}} by an amount that decays over the area's duration.
W.leveling2:
{{st|Magic Damage Per Second|{{ap|20 to 40}} {{as|(+ 10% AP)}}|Total Magic Damage|{{ap|100 to 200}} {{as|(+ 50% AP)}}}}
{{st|Slow|{{ap|40 to 80}}%}}

E.name: Twin Fang
E.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Cassiopeia''' launches her fangs at the target enemy that deal {{pplevel|50 to 120|color=magic damage}} {{as|(+ 20% AP)}} {{as|magic damage}}. If this kills the target, ''Twin Fang's'' {{as|{{sti|mana|mana cost}}}} is refunded.
E.description2: Against a {{tip|poison|poisoned}} target, ''Twin Fang'' deals {{as|'''bonus''' magic damage}} and {{tip|heals}} '''Cassiopeia'''. The heal is reduced by 75% against {{tip|minions}} and small and medium {{tip|monsters}}.
E.leveling2:
{{st|Bonus Magic Damage|{{ap|20 to 120}} {{as|(+ 45% AP)}}|Total Enhanced Damage|{{pp|50 to 118}} (+ {{ap|20 to 120}}) {{as|(+ {{ap|45+20}}% AP)}}}}
{{st|Heal|{{as|{{ap|10 to 16}}% AP}}|Reduced Heal|{{as|{{ap|10*0.25 to 16*0.25}}% AP}}}}

R.name: Petrifying Gaze
R.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Cassiopeia''' blasts enemies in a cone in the target direction, dealing {{as|magic damage}} to enemies struck within and {{tip|slow|slowing}} them by 40% for 2 seconds. Enemies with their facing direction towards her are instead {{tip|stun|stunned}} for the same duration.
